find: Footnote 10 explicitly carved out APA \S\ 706(2) vacatur (which lower courts through 2026 continue to apply universally), and the majority itself identified a properly certified Rule 23(b)(2) class action as the lawful modern descendant of the English bill of peace
replace: Footnote 10 reserved whether the APA authorizes universal vacatur. The Court distinguished certified class relief from a universal injunction by explaining that Rule 23 is the modern counterpart to the bill of peace
reason: CASA expressly declined to decide the distinct APA question. Its account of Rule 23 distinguishes a certified class from relief for unrepresented nonparties.

find: an injunction limited to its own residents would not give it complete relief
replace: an injunction confined to students already residing in the State would not remedy its own financial and administrative injuries
reason: Complete relief for a State is measured by the State's own cognizable injury. Identifying that injury is necessary to distinguish the State's argument from an effort to protect nonparties.
